summary: By the cases of the definition of θ^F_l.

steps.lean:
fun_cases floorMeasure <;> simp [theta_spec, measureH_spec,
    ae_mem_mconv _ (eventually_and.1 ae_mem_floorUnipotent).1 measurableSet_floorGroup,
    ae_map_iff measurable_floorWeyl.fun_inv.aemeasurable, measurableSet_floorGroup, *]
steps.claim: In each case of the definition θ^F_l is carried by H_l: for l < ϱ both weylLaw(l) (w_l(c)⁻¹ ∈ H_l) and η_l (carried by 𝒩_l ⊂ H_l) are, hence their convolution (H_l is a measurable subgroup); for l = ϱ by theta_spec; for l = ϱ + 1 by measureH_spec (𝖧 = H_{ϱ+1}); and δ_1 otherwise.
